events.description: Render the initial 2D loop on the xy-plane with two tracking dots, showing their midpoint and a vertical line representing their distance.
events.clip_query: A 2D loop on a flat plane with two moving dots, a connecting line, and a vertical line indicating distance.

events.description: Generate and render the 3D parametric surface representing all point pairs, with height corresponding to distance.
events.clip_query: A 3D surface rising above a 2D loop, where the height of the surface represents the distance between pairs of points on the loop.

events.description: Rotate the camera to showcase the 3D structure of the surface and its boundary.
events.clip_query: Camera rotating around a 3D surface to show its topological structure from different angles.

events.description: Morph the 2D loop into a new shape, with the 3D surface dynamically updating and morphing its shape in sync.
events.clip_query: A 2D loop changing its shape while the 3D surface above it smoothly deforms and morphs to match the new geometry.
